purpose: Compile narration-bound, non-proof local image prompts that are reproducible, historically constrained, and safe for Pattern Lab.
default_negative_prompt: words, letters, captions, logo, watermark, signature, famous person, identifiable modern landmark, fake map, fake document, malformed hands, extra fingers, duplicate people, distorted face, warped architecture, impossible perspective, muddy shadows, gray haze, low contrast, low saturation, oversharpening, plastic skin, AI artifacts
model_order: Draw Things Z-Image-Turbo after hash-bound benchmark
bounded Codex support only after explicit approval
winner_promotion_note: Attempt Draw Things FLUX.2 Klein img2img only at native draft dimensions. If the verified CLI/model reports its known concat-shape failure, use an explicitly receipted deterministic Lanczos enlargement to 1536x1024. Rejudge the exact final pixels either way.
